R.name: Portal Jump
R.title: Template:Data Zoe/Portal Jump
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Portal Jump|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Zoe
|skill        = R
|icon         = Portal Jump.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Zoe}} {{tip|blinks}} in the target direction, after which she cannot move for a brief moment.
|blurb2      = Afterwards, she {{tip|blinks}} back to her starting position.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} After a {{tt|{{fd|0.15}}-second delay|From the end of the cast time, blink occurs after 0.4 seconds from the start of cast}}, '''Zoe''' {{tip|blinks}} in the target direction and remains there for {{tt|{{fd|0.95}} seconds to {{fd|1.25}} seconds|See notes}}, during which she sets her {{as|movement speed}} to a {{as|static 0|ms}} and has {{tip|unobstructed vision}}. Afterwards, she {{tip|blinks}} back to her casting position.
|description2 = ''Portal Jump {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Zoe's''' basic attack timer. '''Zoe''' {{tt|briefly|See notes}} becomes {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} after casting Portal Jump as well as after blinking back.''
|cooldown     = {{ap|11 to 5}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|cost         = 40
|costtype     = Mana
|range        = 575
|targeting    = Direction
|affects      = Self
|grounded     = true
|flavorsound  = {{sm2|Zoe Original R 1.ogg}} ''"Whoop!"'' 
|notes        = 
* '''Zoe''' will remain at the blink destination for an inconsistent period of time.{{bug|1}}
* ''Portal Jump'' causes '''Zoe''' to become unable to perform any actions for a varied ~{{fd|0.55}}-{{fd|0.75}} seconds{{bug|1}} from the start of the cast time and another time for a varied ~{{fd|0.3}}-{{fd|0.5}} seconds{{bug|1}} starting from right before she blinks back.
* '''Zoe''' is able to perform any action while at the blink destination, except practically being unable to move through normal movement due to having 0 movement speed.
* ''Portal Jump's'' maximum range location, or end position, is determined at the start of the cast time and as such '''Zoe''' will always blink to the determined destination regardless of where she is at the end of the ability's cast time.
* ''Portal Jump'' will always cause '''Zoe''' to {{tip|blink}} back to her casting position regardless of where she is moved to while at the destination.
** She will still be considered to blink even if she fails to move her intended location while {{tip|attach|attached}} (e.g. if she were affected by {{ai|The Show Stopper|Sett}}).
* Upon reaching her destination, '''Zoe''' will either raspberry at the nearest enemy champion, or lick an ice cream cone when there are no enemy champions in {{tip|sight}}.
* '''Zoe's''' return position is shifted by 25 units in the target direction from her cast location.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Zoe''' is locked out during the cast time and for certain periods of time during the ability:
